text:
Ashley: Heads up — noticed agg-hours for eu-prod are ~6h behind and growing.
Mohit: saw that, looks like late Kinesis shard re-opened; spikes in small-day windows.
Tara: any chance it's the recent schema pivot on anonymized user_ids?...
Ashley: schema looks fine; counts indicate missing joins. thinking we should run a staggered slipstream backfill rather than a full reprocess to avoid quota blowouts.
Max: +1. what does 'slipstream' mean here?
Ashley: run small targeted replays (hour buckets) across priority lanes with a 5s inter-burst pause between jobs; reduces slot churn and keeps SLOs.
Mohit: ok. need operator handoff — who can own the runbook and the run command?
Tara: I can own operator step-down after preflight. can we add a console flag to enable 'slipstream' mode so on-call can toggle?
Ashley: yep. patching console: route -> reprocess -> mode (full|slipstream). default full.
Max: what's the preflight? cost estimate and a dryrun that lists affected shards?
Mohit: dryrun CLI prints shard-count + token-estimate. sample:
```
rc reprocess dryrun --env eu-prod --from 2026-03-18T00:00Z --to 2026-03-18T05:00Z
```
ops-bot: dryrun complete: 12 shards, est tokens 3.2M, est cost $12.4
Tara: good. suggest 3 concurrent workers, 10s pause, quota cap of 30% of backfill capacity.
Ashley: agree. also set fallbacks: if error rate >5% for 10m, abort and notify #eng-oncall.
Max: can console show live progress? even basic percent and ETA would help.
Mohit: adding a small progress bar and per-shard latency histo is doable — will tack to the rollout.
Tara: operator handoff: I'll start run at 12:15 UTC, monitoring in #eng-platform, will escalate if SLA misses.
Ashley: note: routing policy — pin these backfills to dedicated 'recompute' slice to avoid impacting production real-time routes.
Mohit: I'll create routing rule: requests with tag=recompute -> recompute-pool, capacity 0.3, burst 0.2
Max: make sure KV cache warming isn't blocked; add prefix cache warm step before replay.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reprocess-controller v2.3 deployed to staging
Ashley: once staging dryrun looks good, we flip console flag to slipstream mode for eu-prod.
Tara: thumbs up. I'll paste run checklist in thread when ready.
Ashley: checklist + commands please. also add quick rollback: cancel job id -> graceful drain -> resume normal routing.
Mohit: created ticket PLATFORM-1428 for routing rule + console flag
Max: thanks. see you at 12:15 — I'll be on pager for console changes.
ops-bot: job 6267890123-1 scheduled by Tara at 2026-03-18T12:15Z
Tara: starting dryrun now...
ops-bot: dryrun logs: shard 3 failed transiently, retried, succeeded. overall ok.
Tara: launching slipstream at 12:26 UTC, handing to Mohit after 10m for monitoring.
Mohit: acknowledged. watching latency and error channels.
Ashley: small note for postmortem: capture token and cost delta, and console UX feedback for toggling modes.
Tara: will file short retrospective in #eng-platform-ops post-run.
Max: nice work team :thumbsup:
